beats.text: Forcing AI to read text one word at a time is the ultimate bottleneck for GPU efficiency.
beats.visual_focus: A singular flickering cursor moving sluggishly across a long chain of text tokens.

beats.text: LSTMs are like a factory conveyor belt where the next item cannot enter until the previous clears, choking throughput and wasting hardware compute.
beats.visual_focus: A stalled conveyor belt showing idle hardware cores waiting on a single sequential signal.

beats.text: The Transformer discards this linear treadmill, replacing complex recurrence with a massive, simultaneous attention mechanism that views the entire sequence at once.
beats.visual_focus: A dense web of connections where every token interacts with every other token concurrently.

beats.text: Instead of waiting, it uses Q, K, and V matrix math to map every token’s relevance to the entire input space instantaneously.
beats.visual_focus: Three distinct matrices projecting into a shared interaction space to compute weights.

beats.text: This architecture shredded previous records, achieving 41.8 BLEU on WMT 2014 and slashing training time significantly.
beats.visual_focus: Performance bar chart showing the Transformer surpassing older ensemble models.
